featured_reviews.review_text:
I will never recommend this doctor to anyone. She does not seem to understand her own work and constantly lies.
When my sister-in-law was 6 months pregnant, she forced her into an abortion. At the same time, I was also pregnant and suffering from serious complications like heart-attack symptoms, risk of stroke, and heavy blood loss. When I went to her, instead of helping, she spoke to me very rudely, saying, “There are so many reports—how can I see all of them? Bring the tablets and show me. Which doctor prescribed these?”
During my sister-in-law’s abortion, she again spoke badly to me and said, “If you can’t tolerate labour pain like your sister-in-law, then we’ll do a C-section.
My sister-in-law’s bill went above ₹1 lakh for just 4 days, and the medicines alone cost ₹35,000. What treatment was actually given? Nothing—she simply performed a C-section and removed the baby.
After this experience, I never went back to her. She had told my sister-in-law that she could have a normal delivery, even though her first delivery was already a C-section. Doesn’t she know basic medical facts—that without proper healing of all layers, normal delivery is not possible? Still, she was giving labour injections. She even told me, “If you can’t tolerate labour pain, we’ll do a C-section.”
Because of this, I changed my gynaecologist and found an excellent doctor. Even when I repeatedly asked for a C-section due to my complications, my doctor did not push me into surgery. She stayed in the hospital from 6 a.m. to 12 p.m. just for me and safely conducted my normal delivery. After reviewing my reports, she clearly told my husband that a C-section was not required. That is what a real doctor looks like.
This woman is only money minded She has nothing but ego, a very rude attitude, and no medical sense at all.
She does not even deserve one star.
